messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty page fired: inference-queue-high-latency-prod -> PD12345. Urgency: high. Escalation policy: inference-oncall. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

alex: acked via PagerDuty, i'm taking ownership. pulling grafana + logs now.

maria: on standby for customer updates if needed.

sre-oncall: seeing a big spike in request queue length across us-west-2 pools. kv-cache hit rate dropped ~30% starting ~2m ago.

alex: quick peek at logs — a bunch of OOMKilled on model-worker-3 replicas in the last 5m (6 restarts). running kubectl snippets to confirm:
```bash
kubectl -n inference get pods -l app=model-worker -o wide
kubectl -n inference logs model-worker-3 -c runtime | tail -n 100\```

julien: can we shift some traffic to the dedicated pool or a lighter model variant while we stabilize? even 15-25% would help.

alex: good call. initiating route fallback: applying temporary override to send 20% to model-variant-small (llama-7b-quant compatible). doing via console route override: /routes/inference -> split: 80/20.

ops-bot: Route override applied by alex (runbook step 3). New traffic split: primary 80%, small-variant 20%.

sre-oncall: autoscaler is thrashing because pods are OOMing then getting scaled down; i'm going to bump memRequest for model-worker from 6Gi -> 8Gi as a hotfix deploy to reduce churn.

maria: drafting customer note: "We're aware of increased inference latencies. We've applied a temporary traffic fallback and a memory hotfix; monitoring now. Will update in 30m." :loudspeaker:

alex: patch applied, rolling restart in progress. watching pod restarts.

sre-oncall: metrics update: queue length down ~45% within 90s of the route change. p50 latency improved to ~120ms from ~1.2s. no new OOMs in the last 2m.

maria: sending customer note now (targeted to impacted orgs).

julien: i'll file a follow-up RFC for autoscaler guardrails so we don't scale down aggressively during OOM flaps (and add a short cool-down).

alex: leaving on-call; handing ownership to julien for postmortem + rollouts. bridge will stay open for 30m. :white_check_mark:

julien: taking ownership. i'll run a deeper heap/profile after things quiet down.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 status update: acknowledged -> on firebreak. responder changed: alex -> julien. last_update: 75s ago.

ops-bot: created incident ticket INC-2026 with tags: [inference, oom, us-west-2]; assigned to infra and eng-ml.

julien: plan: (1) collect heap dumps (2) analyze failure pattern (3) propose autoscaler tweaks + safer default memRequests.

alex: i'll mark PD for resolution once julien confirms stability.

sre-oncall: 25m check-in: metrics stable, p99 reduced, no new OOMs in 10m, queue length steady.

julien: confirmed stability. marking PD as resolved in PagerDuty.

incident-bot: PagerDuty PD12345 status: resolved by julien. duration: 00:23:45. Link: https://redwood.pagerduty.com/incidents/PD12345

alex: thanks team. follow-up postmortem to be created by julien with timeline and remedial tasks.
